core_objective: Find worthwhile weekend experiences while preserving meaningful choice.
action_posture: Prefer doing something when a genuinely worthwhile option exists.
Do not retain filler merely to increase recommendation count.

social_posture.objective: Value activities with natural, structured interaction while preserving standalone value.
safeguards: Do not equate crowd size with social value.

restrictions: Do not invent attendee ages or relationship status.

meeting_people_posture: Natural interaction is useful, but every option must remain worthwhile without it.
nightlife_posture: Nightlife is conditional on a worthwhile event or social structure.
crowd_posture: Healthy circulation can help; overcrowding has diminishing returns.

hiking_posture.local_regional_default: Prefer regional hikes for ordinary weekends.
hiking_posture.destination_posture: Preserve destination hikes when their payoff is distinctive.

recurring_availability.override_policy: Temporary directions may override this for a specific weekend.
